'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Peter Tenneson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Y42 Mains. Peter Tenneson / patmagrain, 2014 Worlds Day 2 08/23/14, 2010 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' patmagrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
